description:
Goal
Make `fz2 build` on a tiny source report only correct, source-actionable diagnostics and expose/avoid material front-door latency.

Signal
`./target/release/fz2 build -o foo fixtures2/00181_enum_reduce_operator_ref.fz` currently takes 110-220 ms, prints four identical spanless warnings for library functions the user did not write, and `--log-telemetry` emits 3,295 events / 2.43 MB while ending about 90 ms before the command exits.

Strategy
Repair authority boundaries rather than suppress symptoms: exhaustiveness must consume declared input domains; the CLI must render the existing structured Diagnostic through a source map; AOT archive discovery/linking must be explicit observable stages and must not invoke Cargo to rediscover a known sibling artifact; telemetry must report bounded decisions/phases and buffer writes rather than expose every pull retry as a costly public trace.

Acceptance
- 00181 emits no false partial-clause warnings.
- A genuine user partial clause renders file, line, snippet, label, note, and help.
- Warm build does not spawn Cargo merely to locate the sibling runtime archive.
- Telemetry covers the complete build through object write/archive resolution/link and stays bounded for this fixture.
- Tests and agent/user docs pin the contracts; temporary probes are removed.

Removal targets
- Domain-free function-head warning decisions where a declared domain exists.
- `ConsoleDiagnosticsHandler` flattened message rendering.
- Per-build Cargo artifact rediscovery for ordinary sibling release/debug builds.
- Per-event JSONL flush and redundant product retry chatter.
title: fz2 build must be fast, observable, and source-actionable
